heading.en: This Order may be cited as the Customs Citation and

text.en: The minimum rent for any period shall be 50 cents.
For the first week or part thereof 50 cents per 100 kilos or part thereof per day reckoned on the gross packed weight of the goods.

heading.en: Warehouse rent shall be paid on all goods Warehouse

text.en:
For the second or any subsequent week or part thereof $1.00 (one dollar) per 100 kilos per day reckoned on the gross packed weight of the goods.

THIRD SCHEDULE Rates of Customs Bonded store rent.

(a) Intoxicating liquors 5 cents per gallon or part thereof

(b) Cigars and Cigarettes 2 cents per mille or part therefore.

(c) Other manufactured 1 cent per lb. net tobacco in containers weight of tobacco or of any kind for retail part thereof. sale to the public

(d) All other dutiable goods

(1) Per package not exceeding 133 1 bs gross weight 15 cents

(2) Per package exceeding 133 lbs gross weight but not exceeding 266 lbs gross weight 30 cents

(3) Per package exceeding 266 1 bs gross weight 60 cents Made this 18th day of August, 1981. Pehin Orang Kaya Lalla Wijaya, Dato Haji Abdul Aziz Umar, State Secretary, Brunei.
